notes: Fixes missing artwork after Movy switched catalog images to relative /img/... paths. Android and Windows now resolve artwork against Movy's HTTPS origin when parsing titles and when loading images, covering Home, Recommended, details, cast artwork and older saved/Continue Watching entries without clearing history or My List. Movy's image-route suffixes and existing absolute image URLs are preserved; Windows retains its JPEG output setting for legacy proxy URLs. Both apps test the same URL-contract fixtures, and Windows smoke checks exercise a relative artwork HTTP request and native bitmap decoding. Existing playback, account connections, quality preferences and update safety remain unchanged.
